checks.evidence: planRetry allows retrying a timed-out POST request on attempt 1 when a non-empty idempotencyKey is provided.
planRetry refuses to retry POST requests lacking a stable idempotencyKey and marks requiresStableIdempotencyKey=true.
planRetry uses finite Retry-After headers in milliseconds, applies exponential backoff up to 4000ms, and stops retrying after attempt 3 or on 4xx client errors.
